templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum that supplements a product agreement when AI services are used, covering input and output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific warranties.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information handled on a covered entity's behalf.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling access to a hosted cloud service, covering subscription access, customer data, payment, warranties, liability, and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-oriented data processing agreement defining controller and processor roles, subprocessor use, security measures, international transfers, and breach notification.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-access design partnerships, covering pre-release product access, feedback, confidentiality, and intellectual property in what the partner helps shape.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA, defining confidential information, permitted use and disclosure, exclusions, and the confidentiality period for both parties.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the mutual NDA, capturing the parties, purpose, term, governing law, and signatures, and incorporating the standard terms by reference.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement between two companies collaborating commercially, covering each party's obligations, referral and revenue arrangements, branding, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-form agreement for a time-limited paid or free product pilot, covering evaluation-only use, the pilot period, and conversion to a full agreement.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Master agreement for professional services delivered under statements of work, covering deliverables, fees, personnel, IP ownership, and acceptance.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms for a cloud service, covering target uptime, downtime calculation, support response times, and service credits as the remedy for misses.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or self-hosted software, covering the licence grant, usage restrictions, support, warranties, and liability.
